to.name: Integrated IS-IS for IP and OSI

property: OSPF and Integrated IS-IS are parallel link-state/SPF IGP families developed from different standards genealogies: an IETF TCP/IP-native OSPF branch and an OSI IS-IS branch extended for IP.

date_or_range.notes: Both became operational choices for IP interior routing.

sources.supports: OSPF IETF link-state/SPF design for TCP/IP
Integrated IS-IS derivation from OSI IS-IS and its IP/OSI dual role

negative_claims: This edge explicitly rejects OSPF→IS-IS or IS-IS→OSPF as a formal revision chain.
Shared use of Dijkstra/SPF does not itself prove direct protocol ancestry.
Specific design cross-influences require committee notes, citations, or participant evidence before being asserted.
open_questions: Search design-group records for documented cross-influence between the two protocol communities.
notes: Another negative-lineage record showing parallel evolution under a shared operational role.
